purpose: Learn construction and selection of a small family instance with an ordered receptor interface, then test its primitive continuations on the untouched held-out24-row incidence goal. This is a proposal/control experiment, not failure-marking learning or a proof claim.

current_geometry.counts_scope: Source-declared only; no model was loaded or recounted for this note.
current_geometry.primitive_graph: Unchanged complete scalar-point graph and mandatory global dead/forced/earliest-generation scheduler.
current_geometry.authority: All171 source bodies retain their existing exact structural relation, native_accepted=false; this does not manufacture native authority.

architecture.unchanged: Keep existing root-fixed Controller and BodyAuthority source/descriptor relation unchanged.
architecture.new_paired_pool_adapter: A separate episode-local immutable proposal pool plus one active whole-hint descriptor, trail and pool revision. A checkpoint records graph/controller checkpoint, active ID, immutable pool snapshot/version, every hint status and construction RNG/event index. Pair restore at child rollback; unknown never excludes.
architecture.pool_storage: Immutable descriptor records once per episode by exact ID; event references plus complete replayable payloads. No unbounded root materialization of all row bindings; no whole trace inflation required by acceptance.
architecture.registration: A newly generated instance receives a fresh small child Controller view with authority-compiled descriptor(s), without editing the root Controller registry. The wrapper tracks/restores those views; no state may disappear from the paired checkpoint.
architecture.continuation: One physical primitive placement at a time through core.Executor.step; resync whole descriptor after every forced/branch effect. If no member touches the current branch, retain waiting state and use complete base fallback. Invalid whole descriptor retires until paired rollback. Never skip a forced move to execute a cluster.

construction_actions.when: Only at an actual graph branch with no active nonretired hint; dead/forced checks first.
sequence: Choose NULL or a generically typed family prototype/open-builder mode.
Choose an anchor from the complete scheduler-selected base domain; no later-generation point becomes an anchor.

Bind ordered exterior ports and internal node/row occurrences from source-compatible literal graph candidates. Alternatively append a legal arbitrary constituent; maximum3logical nodes for the initial pilot.
STOP/COMMIT or append, with a fixed maximum construction horizon. Exact aggregate/interface validation required before commit.
construction_actions.not_just_ranking: The actor chooses topology/row attachment/ordered port bindings and membership, not a weight on a pre-authored target word. A true cluster-use observation requires at least2distinct constituent placements to be executed from one active descriptor; a singleton-only or never-consumed proposal is reported as such.
construction_actions.prototype_provenance: Root-declared generic rule/ordered-port skeletons are authored infrastructure. Additional reusable skeletons may be mined only from engine-generated donor trajectories and only from dependency-complete connected fragments of1–3logical rows. No donor formula word, theorem name, source coordinate or target proof is a template feature. Mined topology and learned policy are separately labeled.
construction_actions.existing_families: The171 checked source-body registry remains available as validation infrastructure. A source-body interface may enter the proposal vocabulary only through an explicitly frozen generic adapter/provenance gate; target-equivalent authored complete proof words and discarded example fields are forbidden as proposals/seeds. Large-body use outside the declared3-node pilot is deferred, not silently counted as active.
construction_actions.open_fallback_shapes: Arbitrary internally valid1–3base-placement clusters remain eligible alongside typed families; their absence never removes a base candidate. The full legal primitive fallback is always present.
construction_actions.arithmetic_role_extent: A logical arithmetic row is4physical C/G/I1/I2 placements. A3logical-row family can therefore have12base placements; open-shape1–3base clusters remain a separate mode. Budgets/reward count primitive work, not macro count.

state_features.generic_only: Structural AST/rule/arity/ordered-port topology, distinct/repeated-slot patterns, closed/nullary term status, row gaps, per-port source completion, pending/selected constituent counts, assigned-zero/absence and remote marking/support work. No hardcoded theorem/predicate/constant names, raw target code, family ID weight, winning seed or proof-word lookup.
state_features.ordered_source_features: Separate each port, not averaged aliases: source-row relation, exact expected-formula agreement, full source-row completeness, repeated-source alias and remaining ordered readers.
state_features.available_formulas: Only dependency-complete selected inference rows count as facts. Physically selected outputs with pending sources and marks on unoccupied rows are constraints, never available facts/reward or installed hypotheses. They may remain explicit pending shape features.
state_features.goal: Initial pilot uses terminal goal reward; no direct goal-code or target-name feature. A generic goal-AST feature is a possible separately frozen successor, not hidden in this plan.
state_features.legality: The complete graph is queried for candidate legality and scheduler decision. Policy features cannot mutate domains, marks, degree counts, exclusions or authority.

completion_predicate.geometry: Row physically selected, command licensed by the fixed context/palette, every ordered source strictly prior and itself dependency-complete with the exact required formula. Recursively close all selected rows in numerical order.
completion_predicate.arithmetic: All4C/G/I1/I2 roles selected; exact C/G command+inference match, modes and all ordered source fields match the current rule, unused ports literal, every required source strictly prior and dependency-complete. A guard/output marking alone is insufficient.
completion_predicate.root_assumptions: Only original declared hypotheses/theory axioms and licensed closed roots; exterior ports never become extra assumptions.
completion_predicate.checking: Producer uses a pinned deterministic predicate; independent audit must reconstruct it from the full primitive state and original rule/context checks before training updates become usable.

policy_math.actor: Linear sparse epsilon-mixture softmax at each construction choice over its exact canonical finite action pool. Initial weights zero; epsilon0.1, temperature1.0, one random.Random.random draw per choice and literal CDF order. No success-seed search.
policy_math.episode_update: Mean of saved choice score-gradients, multiply by advantage R-baseline, then clip actual L2 update direction to1; learning rate0.05. Log preclip norm/clip factor/final increment/all weight hashes. This episode averaging/clipping is an explicit learning heuristic, not an unbiased-gradient claim.
policy_math.baseline: EMA initial0, alpha0.2; advantage uses pre-episode baseline, then baseline updates after the episode. No update for an unexecuted episode. Weights frozen during each complete search.
policy_math.normalizers: Exact rational feature definitions and deterministic float conversion/fsum order must be frozen in implementation before any action/math fixture or execution. Generic API/design is not that implementation.

reward.terminal: Plus1 only for a producer-checked complete finite primitive certificate, provisional until independent full primitive/graph audit. No final solved-theorem count until independent whole primitive/native acceptance.
reward.bounded_shaping: Plus0.05 times maximum number of distinct dependency-complete nonroot formulas seen in the episode divided by declared logical-row count, capped at1. Formula duplicates and repeated rollback rediscovery receive no extra credit; pending outputs/marks receive zero.
reward.costs: Minus0.10*primitive_attempts/attempt_limit; minus0.05*construction_and_validation_checks/check_ceiling; minus0.01*retired_commits/max(1,commits). Each normalized term capped at1. Full wall/preparation/serialization costs remain separately reported; reward is not a speedup certificate.
reward.anti_gaming: No reward for number of proposals/macros, active markings, source-body name, branch depth, unsupported match label or unverified apparent conclusion. All new occupancy and repeated identities validated. Partial shaping is at most0.05 and cannot count as a discovered theorem.
reward.reward_uncertainty: If full donor audit fails or is resource-unknown, its weights are unqualified; stop before trained evaluation, preserve all artifacts and costs.

curriculum.freeze_order: Freeze all donor definitions, target split, complete finite grammar/model recipes, family provenance and seeds before proposal mining/training/search. No authored proofs or ordinary target candidate/witness is input.
curriculum.donor_count: 4declared cases(2per family) ×4predeclared seeds =16episodes. Constant/predicate renaming variants are balancing controls, not independent transfer evidence. All syntax choices must be generated generically, not by a supplied derivation.
curriculum.seed_formula: training seed104729+episode_index; separate evaluation seeds271828 and314159 shared by all stochastic lanes; no outcome-based replacements.
curriculum.first_held_out: Existing frozen24-row incidence target and original context/model; never a donor, weight-tuning case, reward-adaptation run or successful-prefix source. Its existing finite grammar/source inventory is disclosed, so this first test is transfer to a frozen recipient within declared FOL rules, not unrestricted mathematics.

future_family_holdouts.problem_latex: \forall x(P(x)\to Q(x)),\ \forall x(Q(x)\to R(x)),\ P(a)\ \vdash\ R(a)
future_family_holdouts.scope: Composition-depth holdout; components overlap donors, so not disjoint primitive-rule transfer.
Separate arithmetic complete grammar/model/native inventory needed; fragment is current recursively-defined-addition+declared induction, not full PA.

curriculum.model_preparation_gap: New donor models are not prepared or counted here. Before any training, root must freeze a complete bounded primitive inventory/compiler and independently audit each donor context, formula/command/port census and body rebind. If a donor cannot be encoded/checked within ceilings, stop as preparation-unknown; do not supply its proof or silently drop it.
curriculum.alternative: If generic donor preparation is not yet practical, a separately labeled same-theory alternative-goal pilot can test construction/action effect first; it must not be called held-out theorem-family transfer or replace the untouched24-row evaluation.

prospective_resource_gates.activation: No actual source/fixture/model/search/training/native/replay command authorized by this design. ROOT must review exact implementation and independent auditor then issue plan-bound activation.
prospective_resource_gates.preparation: Prospective donor compile/full graph/authority gate:120seconds and512MiB total per donor model;50,000distinct placements ceiling as a feasibility stop, never a reason to shortlist the base universe. Exact counts/serialization bytes/work ceilings fixed before actual compilation. All prep/admission uncertainty/cost retained.
prospective_resource_gates.construction: At most24proposal instances and2048construction+aggregate checks per branch, maximum3logical nodes or3base open-shape members. Truncation is a proposal budget only; no graph-domain restriction.
prospective_resource_gates.action_effect_gate: 2fresh128-attempt/20-second/2000-event observations of the untouched24-row model, identical untrained stochastic policy seeds; full owned75seconds per job/180seconds phase,512MiB. Mandatory independently replayed legal-order effect AND multi-constituent execution before calling the interface actual cluster construction. No proof-success seed.
prospective_resource_gates.training: 16fresh donor episodes,250primitive attempts/10search seconds/2500events each,40seconds full owned job,720seconds phase,512MiB including model/pool/trace/serialization/lifecycle. Phase budget checked before each job; unknown/unexecuted explicit. No native calls in learning producer.
prospective_resource_gates.training_audit: 16full independent donor graph/action/RNG/reward/weight/rollback replays,45seconds each/780seconds phase/512MiB; use bounded stream/disk-backed trace protocol from inception. Training weights cannot qualify without whole phase passed.
prospective_resource_gates.evaluation: 8fresh observations: base,fixed-family,untrained-construction,trained-construction ×2seeds on same frozen24-row model and inventory,128attempts/20search seconds/2000events;75seconds whole owned job/660seconds phase/512MiB. Balanced order r1 base,fixed,untrained,trained; r2 trained,untrained,fixed,base.
prospective_resource_gates.evaluation_audit: All8complete primitive graph/scheduler/whole-hint/pool/RNG/features/reward-source/rollback/census replays,75seconds per job/660seconds phase/512MiB. Preserve every event/node; no whole-tree inflation requirement or evidence reduction.
prospective_resource_gates.native: No native budget granted here. Any automatically found candidate first needs independent whole primitive/point acceptance, exact original request/decoder/capacity preflight, then ROOT separately authorizes unchanged-palette native checking; unknown is not solved.
prospective_resource_gates.ceilings_scope: Prospective upper bounds, not measured feasibility or cost predictions. All worker+owner cleanup, imports, cache prep, feature/construction work, full data serialization, storage/cleanup and auditing included. Source authoring/preparation/reference controls/publication are additional.

controls_and_claim_gates.matched: Same model/context/base inventory/boundary/scheduler/legal candidates/checking semantics and budgets; fixed-family and stochastic lanes use identical learned-template+authored generic inventory. Base lacks proposal overhead by definition, disclosed.
controls_and_claim_gates.ablation: Uniform construction versus learned weights isolates policy effect. Fixed-family uses explicitly authored generic ordering, never called RL. Prototype-source and adapter costs charged separately.
controls_and_claim_gates.proof_count: Only whole independently primitive/native-accepted exact original-theory/target certificates count as solved; region-found or partial fact shaping is not a theorem.
controls_and_claim_gates.help_claim: Actual multi-constituent proposal effect, qualified updates, held-out accepted proof or reliable matched success/cost comparison; matched node counts alone cannot establish practical gain. One recipient/two seeds is a pilot, not statistical superiority.
controls_and_claim_gates.honest_unknowns: Preserve107UNKNOWNs and every older arithmetic/geometry failure. New adapter/training audit resource unknown blocks trained lane; no capped trace is reclassified exhausted or invalid.

source_findings.geometry_fixed_registry_gap: Controller.checkpoint hashes its immutable descriptor registry. Dynamic proposal insertion into it would violate rollback; new wrapper pool/view semantics require independently inspected new source and full rollback/mutation controls.
source_findings.formula_rebinding_gap: BodyAuthority.expected binds rows, not substitutions of formula constants/binders. New family schematic transfer must compile/revalidate in the recipient exact palette/context; literal matching advice cannot establish a new inference.
source_findings.arithmetic_instantiation_gap: Current arithmetic searched contextual rules expose block/refl/generalize, not direct primitive instantiate. The declared primitive_stream contains instantiate schemes outside that searched grammar. Future FOL quantifier advice is not silently enabled in arithmetic.
source_findings.inventory_origin: Checked body infrastructure, mined reusable topology and RL-learned weights are3different provenances; none is automatically a discovered target proof.

authoring_and_evidence.scope: Source reads/hash/literal JSON authoring only. No model/result blob loads, imports of scientific sources, fixtures, engine/checker calls, mining, training/search/native/replay or UI/publication.
